sections.what_happened: 60%+ of Gaza under Israeli military control; Shujayea and Tuffah emptied — VERIFIED FACT of AJ reporting; no independent map verification in this scan.
sections.what_verified: Consistent with prior Yellow Line expansion reporting; no contradictory reporting in window.
sections.what_disputed: Israel has not published its own controlled-area percentage; AJ's figure is its reporting, not an official metric.
sections.why_matters: Six out of every ten square meters of Gaza are now under Israeli military control — two whole neighborhoods emptied while the ceasefire supposedly holds.
sections.context: Background: NEW — Gaza 'Yellow Line' expansion: AJ Gaza report (00:45 GMT): the area under Israeli military control now exceeds 60% of the Gaza Strip; two of Gaza City's most densely populated eastern neighborhoods, Shujayea and Tuffah, are now completely empty of residents; Palestinians in northern areas (Beit Hanoon, Beit Lahiya) cannot return to their homes; Palestinians describe the line as a 'killing zone' vs Israel's 'buffer zone'.

totw_analysis: Our read: Six out of every ten square meters of Gaza are now under Israeli military control — two whole neighborhoods emptied while the ceasefire supposedly holds. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Security buffer that lets displaced Israelis go home — or a land grab shrinking Gaza neighborhood by neighborhood?
